mechanism.claim: During elevated realized variation, John Ehlers' Fisherized deviation-scaled oscillator returning inward through its published +/-2 extremes on completed four-hour BTC auctions identifies a standardized swing beginning to mean-revert; follow the inward direction for twenty-four hours.
mechanism.side: long when finite FisherFilt crosses strictly above -2 from at or below -2; short when it crosses strictly below +2 from at or above +2
mechanism.why_distinct: The oscillator whitens close with a two-decision difference, SuperSmooths at half a 40-period cycle, scales by a 40-decision RMS, and applies a bounded Fisher transform before extreme reentry. It is not a range Fisher Transform, RSI/CCI reentry, moving-average crossover, raw return sum, volume, flow, OI, funding, fitted outcome, reused event set, or promoted control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: a standardized tail excursion must begin reverting while completed trailing twenty-four-hour realized variation ranks in its causal upper 35%
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: sparse Fisherized whitened-spectrum extreme reentries are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.source_bar: exact aggregation of 240 coherent BTCUSDT one-minute rows [T-4h,T)
features.zeros: completed close minus its two-decision lag
features.scaled: filtered value divided by strict-positive RMS over 40 uninterrupted filtered decisions
features.fisher: published half-log Fisher transform, finite only for abs(scaled)<2
features.event: strict inward crossing of -2 or +2 from the immediately prior finite Fisher value
features.variation: sqrt(sum squared completed one-minute open-to-close log returns over [T-24h,T)), finite strict positive
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 180 earlier valid decisions, minimum 120, current excluded; rank>=0.65
features.recursive_reset: all lag, recursive, and RMS state resets after any invalid completed four-hour bar; event requires uninterrupted finite current and prior Fisher values

clock.feature_available: four-hour boundary after completed source bar
clock.entry: exact BTCUSDT open five elapsed minutes later
clock.reservation: global half-open first-eligible reservation; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: published Ehlers FDSO(40) +/-2 inward reentry under the requested high-variation regime

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure; no period, recursion, RMS, transform, threshold, variation, side, hold, clock, subset, control, or other repair.

external_basis.origin: John F. Ehlers, Probability—Probably A Good Thing To Know, Fisherized Deviation Scaled Oscillator, TASC October 2018
external_basis.fixed_definition: Period=40; Zeros=Close-Close[2]; SuperSmoother critical period=20; RMS over 40 filtered values; ScaledFilt=Filt/RMS; Fisher=.5*log((1+ScaledFilt/2)/(1-ScaledFilt/2)) for abs(ScaledFilt)<2; overbought=2 and oversold=-2; inward crossings
external_basis.selection_use: published default period, formula, thresholds, and entry direction only; no incidence or outcomes
